column1: # docs/perf-anchors.tsv — the standing chart's data. Update this, then run
# scripts/render-perf-chart.sh (the SVG is generated; never hand-edit it).
# The campaign's summary phase and the docs guard run --check to flag staleness.
# The bar (user, 2026-10-23): this line succeeds when it surpasses production 0.6.6 on
# loading time, generation tok/s, and prefill rate.
# The quality bar (user, 2026-10-27): hardmode is THE quality measure — beat production's
# run-level 94 or come close. The served default is now the Focus checkpoint (92 run-level,
# 86% subset); the top4cfg (89 / 76%) stays receipted as the perf leader.
